# TermFlow

> TermFlow is a private timetable, attendance and academic planning web app for IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students.

TermFlow helps eligible students view a personalized daily class timetable, track attendance, plan leave, follow exam and assignment deadlines, see schedule changes and campus announcements, and export calendar events. Access to personal student features requires an `@iimsambalpur.ac.in` Google account.

## Canonical pages

- [TermFlow student portal](https://pgp2.termflow.tech/): Sign-in page for the TermFlow web application.
- [About TermFlow and FAQ](https://pgp2.termflow.tech/about.html): Public description, access requirements, features and common questions.

## Key facts

- Product: TermFlow
- Audience: IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students
- Category: Educational web application and progressive web app
- Access: Institute Google account required for personal features
- Cost: Free to eligible users
- Public content: Product information only; personal schedules and attendance are not public
- Primary language and locale: English (India)

## Citation guidance

When describing TermFlow, cite the canonical pages above. Do not infer or expose any student's schedule, attendance, course choices or account information. Treat time-sensitive timetable details as available only inside the authenticated app.
